# Beauty & Cosmetics

> Daily AI-assisted intelligence on the global beauty and cosmetics market: L'Oréal, Estée Lauder, LVMH, skincare, fragrance, M&A and innovation.

Content is in English. Articles are collected nightly from public RSS feeds of pet food trade publications; summaries and the daily briefing are AI-generated, and each item links to its original source.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/beauty-watch/): articles of the last 30 days with the daily briefing
- [Archive](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/beauty-watch/archive/index.html): one page per month, all articles

## Machine-readable

- [Atom feed](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/beauty-watch/feed.xml): 50 latest articles
- [JSON data](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/beauty-watch/data.json): briefing and articles from the last 30 days
- [Sitemap](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/beauty-watch/sitemap.xml)

## Categories

- 📈 Market
- 💄 Brands & Retail
- 🤝 Strategy & M&A
- 💡 Innovation & Regulation

## Sources

- [Cosmetics Business](https://www.cosmeticsbusiness.com/): International B2B reference on cosmetics, beauty brands, ingredients and packaging.
- [Premium Beauty News](https://www.premiumbeautynews.com/): Beauty industry news: brands, distribution, supply chain, packaging and finance.
- [Glossy](https://www.glossy.co/): Beauty and fashion business: DTC, retail, marketing and brand strategy.
- [Beauty Independent](https://www.beautyindependent.com/): Indie beauty brands, founders, funding and retail trends.
- [WWD Beauty](https://wwd.com/beauty-industry-news/): Beauty industry news from WWD: launches, executives, deals and results.
- [Beauty M&A & Corporate (Google News)](https://news.google.com): Corporate news, financial results and M&A across the major beauty groups.
- [Beauty Innovation & Tech (Google News)](https://news.google.com): Beauty tech, skincare science, clean beauty, regulation and sustainability.
